{{Quote|Would you join me for a little refreshment? Everyone's invited of course.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="TESB" />}}
The '''Cloud City dining room''',<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=video/refreshments|text=Refreshments}}</ref> also known as the '''Cloud City Dining Hall''',<ref name="TCG">{{TCG|set=The Empire Strikes Back|cardname=Cloud City Dining Hall|link=https://swtcg.com/Content/Images/Cards/ESB/Cloud_City_Dining_Hall.webp?v=2}}</ref> was located on Cloud City. Accompanying his compatriots for what they believed to be some light but satisfying refreshments, as well as a brief mention of a plan to get Imperial influence out of Cloud City, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] led them towards this room, and their betrayal. Waiting within the confines of this room were both [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. With the closure of the room's doors, their fates were sealed.<ref name="TESB" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In both the standard ''Robot Chicken'' episode ''Moesha Poppins'' and the special ''[[Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode II]]'', one of the clips featured an extension of the dining room betrayal scene featuring what happened during the actual dinner. Calrissian made a brief quip about his betrayal, Vader inquires about Alderaan to Organa, and Solo and Fett non-verbally taunt each other with the food.
